headline: UNIDIR examined the missing links between space and ICT diplomacy, as US voters revolted against AI data center buildouts at the midterms and OpenAI's autonomous pipeline patched nearly 1,000 Linux kernel vulnerabilities.

points.text: UNIDIR examined the missing links between outer space diplomacy and the security of information and communications technologies, following a panel at Geneva Cyber Week.
SIPRI published a climate, peace and security fact sheet on Somalia.
Axios reported that US voters revolted against the AI race at the midterms, approving dozens of data center moratoriums and electing candidates favoring a slower buildout, including in Texas.
Transformer argued that the 'blue tsunami' at the midterms makes stronger AI legislation look much more likely.
OpenAI said an autonomous pipeline it built found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
The UK outlined its candidacy for re-election to the International Telecommunication Union Council in 2026.
